title: A pushed picture's title, slug, caption and description are written after its upload, and edits of an existing picture are sent
steps: Run the live-push-changeset cases for #223: a new picture titled otherwise than its file, an existing picture with a new title and caption, a picture whose upload is not sent.
expect: mediaText:new:60 is a post update on {$new: posts:60} depending on media:new:60, writing the title, slug and description, with a seed naming them; mediaText:50 writes title and caption at the live address with expect; no words for an upload not sent.
evidence: Issue #223 re-test: a picture titled "RT picture" was kept as delete-modify; the push sent only the file

tests: WordPress: a new picture titled otherwise than its file
WordPress: no words are written for a picture whose upload is not sent
